title: As Michigan forges forward on literacy, many ask: What about math?
summary_en: In a state laser focused on literacy, educators and leaders say more attention needs to be paid to math.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: As Michigan forges forward on literacy, many ask: What about math?

title: As enrollments plummet, Michigan communities sweat job losses from universities
summary_en: For communities around many of Michigan’s public universities, declining enrollments and inadequate state funding may have severe adverse economic impacts.
author: Shaina Sternhell, Capital News Service
title_cn: As enrollments plummet, Michigan communities sweat job losses from universities
